free.label: Free
free.subtitle: In-house
free.tagline: Our own 3D engine. Zero per-reel render cost.
free.summary: Declarative 3D scenes (three.js), real physics simulation, KaTeX maths, synced neural voice and captions. Runs on your machine; only the script LLM call costs anything.
highlights: Physics simulator checked against textbook formulas
Layout lint and vision QA with one auto-retry
Best for physics, chemistry and maths

premium.label: Premium
premium.subtitle: Generated imagery + selective video
premium.tagline: Photoreal scenes for history, civics and biology.
premium.summary: Generated stills with in-house camera moves, plus a few short generated video clips on the key moments. Provider adapters and a hard spend cap per reel.
highlights: Generated stills with parallax and camera moves
2–4 short video clips per reel, at 720p
Hard spend cap enforced before every call

ultra.label: Ultra
